data.fixed_clause: Submission of this employment application and participation in the preliminary evaluation stages constitutes the applicant's authorization for the company to process, retain, and continuously utilize all submitted information across current and future internal business operations, with such authorization subject to withdrawal by the data subject at any time as permitted by law.
